data.narrative:
Together AI, a Series G AI & Software company, is valued at $8.3B post-money following $530M in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws on a universe of 12 same-sector peers spanning similar valuation tiers, including 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers such as Figure AI ($39.0B), Scale AI ($29.0B), and Applied Intuition ($15.0B). The peer set ranges from $2.0B to $39.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.25x multiplier typical of Series G advancement, yields $10.4B. Peer-median analysis across the 12-company comp set produces $9.3B, with the median substantially anchored by later-stage and comparably valued firms within the AI infrastructure landscape.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $7.9B (low) to $11.9B (high), with a median implied value of $9.8B. The current $8.3B post-money sits at the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties include the significant dispersion within the peer set (39x range from floor to ceiling) and the early-stage nature of several high-valuation comps, which may not reflect execution or revenue maturity comparable to Together AI's Series G positioning. Revenue visibility and unit economics would refine this assessment materially.
